lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Honeyed Morning Yogurt
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with sunflower seeds and honey
dishes.method: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl, drizzle with honey and top with the sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A high-protein start that requires no cooking, perfect for a busy Wednesday morning.

dishes.name: Zesty Roast Chicken Rice
dishes.title: Roast chicken thighs with yellow peppers, courgettes and rice
dishes.method: Assemble a portion of the prepped chicken, rice, and roasted vegetables. Squeeze over fresh lemon juice and serve.
dishes.why: Uses the fresh batch of chicken and loud yellow vegetables for a muscle-building lunch.

dishes.name: Savoury Beef and Spinach Bowls
dishes.title: Sautéed beef mince with spinach over rice
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of the beef and rice in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Stir through to combine.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-dense dinner using the prepped beef and rice batch.

dishes.name: Blueberry Seeded Yogurt
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with fresh blueberries and seeds
dishes.method: Top the yogurt with blueberries and seeds. Simple and quick while the hallway is being painted.
dishes.why: High protein and no-cook, ideal when the kitchen access is restricted.

dishes.name: Summer Veg Chicken Wrap
dishes.title: Chicken and roasted vegetable wraps
dishes.method: Slice the cold chicken and vegetables. Fill the wraps and roll tightly. Easy to eat without a table.
dishes.why: A portable lunch designed for when the kitchen table is under a dust sheet.

dishes.name: Warm Lemon Chicken Rice
dishes.title: Pan-warmed chicken, rice and yellow peppers
dishes.method: Toss the chicken, rice, and peppers in a pan with lemon juice and a splash of water until warm. Serve in a bowl.
dishes.why: Osric's rule for a warm element at dinner, served in a bowl for easy eating away from the table.

dishes.name: Protein-Packed Scrambled Eggs
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs on toasted bread
dishes.method: Whisk the eggs and scramble in a pan with oil. Serve on toast (remove crusts for Wilfrid).
dishes.why: Fresh protein to support muscle gain at the end of the week.

dishes.name: Quick Beef and Rice
dishes.title: Beef and spinach rice bowl
dishes.method: Warm the remaining beef and rice in a pan. Stir well to ensure it is heated through.
dishes.why: A quick, warm lunch to finish the prepped batch.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Fish and Greens
dishes.title: White fish fillets with roasted courgettes
dishes.method: Sear the fish fillets in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side. Serve with the final portion of roast vegetables.
dishes.why: Freshly cooked fish provides a light but protein-rich dinner to end the stretch.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs
preparations.method: Rub chicken with oil and rosemary. Roast at 200C for 35-40 minutes until cooked through and golden.

preparations.title: Large pot of fluffy rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in salted water for 12-15 minutes. Drain and fluff with a fork.

preparations.title: Roasted summer vegetables
preparations.method: Chop vegetables into chunks, toss with oil and salt, and roast at 200C for 25-30 minutes.

preparations.title: Beef and spinach sauté
preparations.method: Brown beef with minced garlic. Once cooked, stir in the spinach until wilted. Season well.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat oven to 200C. Chop veg and season chicken, then get both in the oven. Start the rice on the stove. While everything cooks, brown the beef and wilt the spinach. Drain rice and box everything up once cooled.
